title: SE coaching + ops docket - weekly prep
content:
Purpose: quick prep for weekly SE <> AE coaching + ops sync. Mix of coaching topics, customer escalations to triage, and handoffs for Dedicated onboarding. Keep it lightweight (~30m) and action-oriented.

Meeting goals:
- 1 quick coaching nugget (skill / feedback loop)
- Triaging 2 active customer ops items that need SE involvement
- Confirm next-step owners & dates for Dedicated onboards / escalations

Agenda (30 min)
1) 5 min - Check-in + priorities this week (what’s blocking you)
2) 7 min - Coaching nugget: debugging cold-start latency regressions (short checklist + signal to look for)
3) 10 min - Customer ops triage (Arcadia Health, LuminaPay) + tickets to assign
4) 6 min - Handoffs & follow-ups (Dedicated capacity rollouts, security questionnaire)

Prep notes / prompts to ask during 1:1:
- What customer demos or escalations this week require me to be on the call? (get exact times)
- Any log patterns or KB gaps you hit while troubleshooting? (capture to Confluence)
- Which internal folks (SRE, Infra, CCM) should we loop in preemptively?

Coaching nugget (micro lesson): cold-start/regression quick checklist
- Reproduce with short seq / trimmed prompt to confirm baseline
- Check model variant and quantization profile (is it a fallback variant?)
- Observe runtime metrics: first-token P95, model load time, GPU mem spike
- If KV cache miss rate high, consider prefix caching or warmup RPC
- If we see sustained >2x baseline, file INF-2321 (include perf trace + kernel logs)
Notes: demo a short repro in next AE customer handoff call — show warmup artifact and explain tradeoff of warmup cost vs 1st-token reduction.

Customer ops triage (detailed)
1) Arcadia Health (mid-Enterprise, Dedicated onboarding)
- Current: onboarding scheduled next week; dedicated pool allocation delayed due to VM imaging issue.
- Key tickets: CS-879 (image validation), INF-2321 (warm startup perf observed in staging)
- Risk: PHI-sensitive workload, needs SOC2 checklist signed before go-live.
- Today: confirm infra owner for image rebuild (Diego?) and set a plan B: temporary hosted route with strict routing & VPC peering.
- Talking points for AE: communicate 48h contingency plan and temporary SSO config.
- Action items:
  - [ ] Diego Morales: own image rebuild, ETA 2026-03-16 (comment on CS-879)
  - [ ] Lena Park: prepare hosted-route fallback playbook + instructions to legal for SOC2 questions, due 2026-03-14
  - [ ] Priya Nair: schedule a short runbook walkthru with Arcadia on 2026-03-17

2) LuminaPay (scale pilot, high token volume)
- Current: token spikes cause transient retries -> downstream duplicate charges risk. Observed higher retry rate between 03:00–05:00 UTC.
- Telemetry: spike correlated with batch job run; autoscaler not triggering in time.
- Temporary mitigation: throttle burst from integration side + increase burst pool for Dedicated this week.
- Action items:
  - [ ] Ethan Kim: check autoscaler logs and adjust policy (increase aggressiveness for short spikes), due 2026-03-13
  - [ ] AE (Nina): ask partner to shift batch window if possible; propose a canary on lower token limit during next run
  - [ ] Lena Park / SE: draft guidance for safe dedup semantics and idempotency for payment flows, due 2026-03-18

Handoffs & security/compliance items
- SOC2 question set (Arcadia): attach minimal answers and KMS diagram. Use Confluence page (see linked_artifacts) as source of truth.
- Private deployment checklist: ensure KMS key rotation policy called out + customer audit window.
- Action items:
  - [ ] Lena Park: update Private-deploy checklist excerpt in Confluence and link to customer email (due 2026-03-14)
  - [ ] Diego Morales: confirm HSM/KMS integration config with infra (due 2026-03-15)

Unresolved questions / open risks to surface
- Do we have a documented SLA for transient duplicate prevention guidance? (not clearly defined)
- Can we get a short perf SLA for first-token P95 on Dedicated vs Hosted? Ops says not yet formalized.
- Who signs off on Arcadia SOC2 answers—Legal or Security? (loop in Priya Legal contact)

Quick links to docs / tickets to pull into the call:
- INF-2321 (perf traces attached)
- CS-879 (Arcadia image validation)
- Confluence: Private Deploy security checklist (pageId=4648239)
- Runbook: hosted-fallback-for-dedicated.md (internal snippet in team drive)

Meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack after call)
- Summary: (1 short sentence)
- Decisions made: (list)
- Actions: (owner, ticket, due date)
- Next check-in: (date/time)

Notes-to-self (for coaching cadence):
- Call out one specific thing the SE did well (positive reinforcement)
- One growth area: encourage more proactive infra triaging (pair debug 1x per month)
- Rotate weekly micro-lessons: perf, security, rollout, rollback, observability

Final quick checklist before meeting:
- [ ] Pull latest traces for INF-2321 (attach to JIRA)
- [ ] Confirm Arcadia meeting time and attendee list
- [ ] Upload SOC2 Qs answers draft to Confluence + ping Legal
- [ ] Draft Slack follow-up template and copy into meeting notes

End of scratchpad.

(Temporary notes: keep this doc ephemeral — once actions are created in JIRA / Confluence, archive the gist to avoid stale copy.)
